item.text: {"searches":[{"reason":"Develop controlled probes that distinguish reliance on recent, repeated interests from broad historical affinity. Compare last-position rankings under recent-item masking, older-history truncation, and order shuffling, using matched random edits as controls. Connect measured sensitivity to sequence encoding and recency weighting without treating perturbations as causal evidence of user intent.","query":"sequential recommendation diagnostic evaluation temporal shortcut learning history perturbation recent interaction masking repeated interests SASRec 2024 2025 2026"},{"reason":"Translate user feedback into evidence-backed diagnostics for direct relevance, unsupported compatibility, and overlapping recommendations. Seek methods using only available titles, descriptions, and histories, with explicit abstention when specifications or unmet needs cannot be established. Establish whether a probe predicts validation HR@10 gains across all four datasets before using it to choose model changes.","query":"recommender diagnostic validity sampled evaluation full catalog ranking popularity bias negative sampling bootstrap uncertainty metric predictive validity HR@10 2024 2025 2026"}]}
